heading_path: Part 10—Assignment and transmission of trade marks
111  Notification of application to be given to person recorded as claiming interest in trade mark etc.
text: If an application made under section 107 or 109 in relation to the assignment or transmission of a trade mark complies with this Act, the Registrar must notify in accordance with the regulations any person recorded under Part 11 as claiming an interest in, or a right in respect of, the trade mark.
